title: 黎曼猜想证明经 Lean 官方核验无误
content: The proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, developed by mathematician Levent Alpöge and Claude, has been formally verified by the Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative communities. It satisfies four rigorous verification criteria from Imperial College London and passed multiple independent Lean kernel checks without additional assumptions. This achievement marks the resolution of one of the three major unsolved Millennium Prize Problems. The event highlights the emerging paradigm of collaborative problem-solving between artificial intelligence and human mathematicians in tackling top-tier mathematical challenges, prompting further academic focus on remaining unsolved problems.

content: Tesla has begun pushing its Full Self-Driving (FSD) V15 update, which comprehensively upgrades the end-to-end driving network. content: Two Russians impersonated Ukraine’s head of foreign intelligence to conduct a 17-minute video call with three OpenAI national security executives. They have a history of impersonating Ukrainian officials, including President Zelensky.
